note: Replaces the 'instagram' entry of capabilities.json ONLY while the Instagram service is configured (IG_SERVICE_URL + IG_SERVICE_API_KEY). Every supported action has a handler in ig-service/app.py and a case in social/ig_engine.js — tests/ig-engine.test.js fails if they ever drift. Without the service the base manifest applies unchanged.

search.reason: The Instagram service has no keyword post search.

view_profile.returns: name, bio, followers, following, posts, private/verified

view_posts.returns: recent posts: URL, caption, likes, comments, date

view_feed.returns: her home feed: URL, author, caption (up to 10)

comment.notes: Comment on a post or reel.

reply.reason: Replying to one specific comment is not implemented in the Instagram service — it can comment on a post, not reply to a comment.

connect.reason: Connection requests are a LinkedIn concept; Instagram has no equivalent.

dm.notes: Replies only: she answers people who already messaged her and never starts a conversation (the service checks the inbox and refuses otherwise).

read_dms.returns: latest 10 conversations: who and the last message

post.notes: A picture plus caption (pass image_url, https). The picture is converted to a JPEG and cropped into Instagram's feed ratio. No text-only posts, no video.

repost.reason: Not implemented in the Instagram service.

notifications.reason: Not implemented in the Instagram service.

delete_post.reason: Not implemented — deleting is deliberately left out.

delete_comment.reason: Not implemented — deleting is deliberately left out.
